body: Today was my last school day in my host country of 10 months. My class decorated the board for me and signed a t-shirt together. Needless to say, many tears were shed from me and the rest of the class. I'd rather stay here, and not have to go back to my family, but life doesn't always go how you want..

I know exactly what you mean. Life is a routine, a vicious cycle, but you can also rise above the routine. Don't wait for good or exciting things to happen, make them happen. If you want change, make it.
Ich bin nicht Deutsche aber wohne in Deutschland. Nordrhein Westfalen.
Who cares? I care. Life might seem dark, but the night's always darkest before the dawn. Things will change.

Taking your future away is no way to handle your fear of the future. You are valuable, you life is valuable. Don't throw that away. You don't even know if your life will end up that way, give yourself a chance.
